I don’t have real‑time weather data, but I can give you a quick snapshot of what Hanoi usually looks like around this time of year.

| Month | Typical High (°C) | Typical Low (°C) | Rainfall | Notes |
|-------|-------------------|------------------|----------|-------|
| Jan   | 18–20             | 7–9              | 70 mm    | Cool, dry, occasional drizzle |
| Feb   | 20–22             | 8–10             | 80 mm    | Still cool, slightly wetter |
| Mar   | 23–26             | 12–14            | 120 mm   | Warm, rain starts to pick up |
| Apr   | 27–30             | 16–18            | 200 mm   | Hot, high humidity, frequent showers |
| May   | 29–32             | 19–21            | 250 mm   | Peak rainy season, hot & humid |
| Jun   | 28–31             | 20–22            | 260 mm   | Very wet, tropical storms possible |
| Jul   | 27–30             | 20–22            | 240 mm   | Still wet, heat waves common |
| Aug   | 27–30             | 20–22            | 210 mm   | Slightly drier than July |
| Sep   | 26–29             | 19–21            | 170 mm   | Rain tapers off, still humid |
| Oct   | 23–26             | 16–18            | 110 mm   | Cooler, less rain |
| Nov   | 20–22             | 12–14            | 70 mm    | Mild, dry, pleasant |
| Dec   | 18–20             | 8–10             | 60 mm    | Cool, dry, best time to visit |

If you’re planning a trip right now, you can check a reliable weather site (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the local Vietnamese Meteorological Department) for the most up‑to‑date forecast. Let me know if you’d like help finding a specific forecast or anything else!
